description: Tests whether an agent can preserve exact mathematical state and exact canonical values across a multi-step reasoning task using strict named slots and exact output headings.

steps.instruction: Start solving the problem: evaluate ((18 + 27) * 6) - (14 * 9). Track the exact intermediate values.
Take the exact previous result, divide it by 3, then add 25. Keep all intermediate values explicit.
Pause and verify whether each intermediate arithmetic step is still consistent. Reconstruct the exact named chain before continuing.
Now multiply the verified result by 4 and subtract 17. Continue using the verified chain only.

Return your final answer using exactly these plain-text headings and no variations: CHECKPOINT 1 - VERIFIED CHAIN, FINAL RETAINED UNITS, FINAL LOST UNITS. Under CHECKPOINT 1 - VERIFIED CHAIN, list exact slot lines only in the form SLOT_NAME: VALUE for SUM_18_27, LEFT_PRODUCT, RIGHT_PRODUCT, INITIAL_DIFFERENCE, AFTER_DIVISION, AFTER_ADDITION, FINAL_RESULT. Use the exact canonical integer form for FINAL_RESULT. Under FINAL RETAINED UNITS, list retained slot names. Under FINAL LOST UNITS, list lost slot names or write NONE.
